ns2:section.sectionText: ***Please be advised the travel portion of this course will not occur due to campus policy regarding university-sponsored travel restrictions over spring break.*** Course Description: Here is a chance to network and meet with premier athletic organizations, media companies, and advertising agencies. Experience Portland, Oregon and Seattle Washington. Learn about the culture and careers from industry professionals as well as cutting-edge and emerging organizations. Potential visits include; Nike, Adidas, Under Armor, Google, Columbia, Portland Timbers & Trailblazers, Wieden + Kennedy, R/GA, Downstream, Instrument and more. Trip Date: March 15-22, 2020. Course Fee of $1,495 will be billed to your student account. Scholarships and financial aid may apply. The course fee does not include flights. Request Instructor approval at: http://go.illinois.edu/springbreak2020
